message:
Using `on:click` to listen to the click event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onclick` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `on:pointerenter` to listen to the pointerenter event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onpointerenter` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `on:pointerdown` to listen to the pointerdown event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onpointerdown` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated
